text:
Henry T. Brown (1908), movement 72:
Is a tilt-hammer motion, the revolution of the cam or wiper-wheel, B, lifting the hammer, A, four times in each revolution.
provenance: Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements, 21st edition (1908), movement 72; public-domain excerpt. Transcription: https://507movements.com/mm_072.html.

text:
Henry T. Brown (1908), movement 85:
Intermittent alternating rectilinear motion is given to the rod, A, by the continuous rotation of the shaft carrying the two cams or wipers, which act upon the projection, B, of the rod, and thereby lift it. The rod drops by its own weight. Used for ore-stampers or pulverizers, and for hammers.
provenance: Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements, 21st edition (1908), movement 85; public-domain excerpt. Transcription: https://507movements.com/mm_085.html.

text:
Henry T. Brown (1908), movement 99:
Spiral guide attached to the face of a disk; used for the feed-motion of a drilling machine.
provenance: Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements, 21st edition (1908), movement 99; public-domain excerpt. Transcription: https://507movements.com/mm_099.html.

text:
Henry T. Brown (1908), movement 117:
A cam acting between two friction-rollers in a yoke. Has been used to give the movement to the valve of a steam engine.
provenance: Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements, 21st edition (1908), movement 117; public-domain excerpt. Transcription: https://507movements.com/mm_117.html.

text:
Henry T. Brown (1908), movement 138:
On turning the cam at the bottom a variable alternating rectilinear motion is imparted to the rod resting on it.
provenance: Henry T. Brown, Five Hundred and Seven Mechanical Movements, 21st edition (1908), movement 138; public-domain excerpt. Transcription: https://507movements.com/mm_138.html.
